## Before submitting

- [x] I agree to license this contribution under the terms of [LICENSE.txt](https://github.com/NVIDIA/cudnn-frontend/blob/develop/LICENSE.txt).
- [x] I ran `pre-commit run` and committed any formatting changes.
- [x] I reviewed the Hard Rules in the `AGENTS.md` for each directory this PR touches (see [root AGENTS.md § Reviewing a PR](https://github.com/NVIDIA/cudnn-frontend/blob/develop/AGENTS.md#reviewing-a-pr-human-or-agent)) and my changes comply, or I explain the exception below.
- [x] I added GitHub labels: one `cat-*`, one or more `area:*` / `op:*`, and one `orig-*` (see [label list](https://github.com/NVIDIA/cudnn-frontend/labels)).

## Affected area

Build, packaging, or installation; documentation and container recipes.

## Summary

Require `nvidia-cutlass-dsl[cu13]>=4.8.0`, preserving the Windows ARM64 exclusion. Update the three Docker recipes that explicitly install older DSL releases, and align package-floor documentation and agent guidance.

## Why

The latest stable downstream releases, verified on 2026-10-23, already pin CuTe DSL 4.8.0:

- [vLLM v0.32.0](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/releases/tag/v0.32.0): [requirements/cuda.txt, line 22](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/blob/v0.32.0/requirements/cuda.txt#L22).
- [SGLang v0.5.22](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/releases/tag/v0.5.22): [python/pyproject.toml, line 53](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/v0.5.22/python/pyproject.toml#L53).

Both release tags declare:

> `nvidia-cutlass-dsl[cu13]==4.8.0`

Use `>=4.8.0` here to align the minimum with those released consumers while allowing later patch releases.

The previous 4.6.2 floor and its downstream-compatibility explanation are outdated for these releases.

## Related issues

Related to #1819, which proposes a 4.7.1 floor and a separate JAX minimum update. This PR targets the 4.8.0 baseline already used by the released downstream consumers; it does not change JAX requirements.

## API and compatibility impact

Installations pinned below CuTe DSL 4.8.0 must upgrade. The CUDA extra and platform marker are preserved. Kernel-specific runtime version/architecture checks remain intact, including guards for environments that bypass dependency resolution. Python/C++ APIs and the optional JAX dependency group are unchanged.

## Testing

- `setuptools.build_meta.prepare_metadata_for_build_wheel(...)` — generated package metadata successfully. Verified the DSL requirement accepts 4.8.0/4.8.1, excludes 4.7.1/4.8.0.dev0, and retains the Windows ARM64 exclusion.
- Resolved generated required dependencies with `nvidia-cutlass-dsl==4.8.0`, using `uv pip compile --python-version 3.12 --python-platform x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu --no-build` — 10 packages resolved; all DSL companion libraries are 4.8.0.
- Resolved the DSL dependency chain at Python 3.10 on Linux ARM64 and Windows x64 — passed.
- `pre-commit run --files <all changed files>` — passed.
- `git diff --check` — passed.

GPU regression suites and Docker image builds were not run locally: this host has no usable NVIDIA GPU. Downstream dependency pins establish the shared installation baseline, not a claim of GPU regression coverage for this PR.

**Codex bot review · model: `gpt-6-astra`**

Reviewed `261f707866c3` against base `c8fe8c9b11cf`.

The released downstream pins support this floor change. Generated package metadata and dependency resolution are correct, and bounded native tests pass on the exact public DSL 4.8.0 release. I found no P0/high-risk P1. Coordinate the CI environment constraints below before relying on test pipelines for this revision; the existing approval remains appropriate.

**[P2] Update CI environment constraints with the package floor** ([source](https://github.com/NVIDIA/cudnn-frontend/blob/261f707866c3cfde2d9e574679809b9798507a7f/pyproject.toml#L53))

Current test environments still constrain DSL below the new minimum. Resolving those constraints together with the generated wheel requirements fails before tests can run. Coordinate compatible environment pins with this change and obtain a run that installs this wheel. The current Style/Docs checks do not validate that installation path.

Evidence: Fresh current CI configuration checked; its joint wheel/runtime install retains incompatible DSL constraints. The actual generated requirements plus the older exact pin produce an unsatisfiable resolver result, while the 4.8.0 control resolves successfully on three supported platforms. Attribution: Integration conflict introduced by raising the package minimum without the matching CI environment update; runtime code is unchanged.

Validation: Verified the immutable [vLLM v0.32.0 requirement](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/blob/v0.32.0/requirements/cuda.txt#L22) and [SGLang v0.5.22 requirement](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/v0.5.22/python/pyproject.toml#L53): both pin DSL 4.8.0. The public 4.8.0 distribution is available and supports Python >=3.10. Generated setuptools metadata; verified accepted/rejected versions and the preserved Windows ARM64 exclusion. Required dependencies pinned to the new floor resolve for Python 3.10 on Linux x64, Linux ARM64 and Windows x64. Exact-head Python source, isolated public CuTeDSL 4.8.0, native SM100, Torch 2.14/cu130 and cuDNN 9.26: 31 GLU/Hadamard tests and 14 MXFP8 SDPA tail tests passed; one two-device test skipped. All 57 core import/version checks passed, with top-level lazy-import checks separately confirmed in fresh processes. Reviewed all 13 changed files and comments; no runtime logic changes or precheck candidates. Existing public checks passed. Project membership added; existing appropriate labels retained. Milestone remains unset because release intent is not stated.

Limitations: No full Docker image builds, native Windows/ARM64 tests, all-kernel/device matrix, JAX execution or performance qualification. The dependency floor requires users pinned below 4.8.0 to upgrade, as the PR states. GPU CI deferred until its environment constraints support the generated wheel; launching the current configuration would stop at dependency resolution. The existing platform-qualification documentation comment remains nonblocking.

Comment only: this PR already has an active approval; preserving existing approvals.

 - `include/` is header-only: no `.cpp` files, no new required dependencies. Vendored third-party code lives in `include/cudnn_frontend/thirdparty/`.
 - Every new frontend-only Python API needs: public functions, lazy export in `python/cudnn/ops/__init__.py`, docs under `docs/fe-oss-apis/`, and pytest coverage under `test/python/fe_api/`. Full recipe: [python/cudnn/AGENTS.md](python/cudnn/AGENTS.md) and the `cutedsl-kernel-integration` skill.

-- The `pyproject.toml` floor on `nvidia-cutlass-dsl` (`>=4.6.2`) is the **downstream** floor (vLLM/SGLang inherit quack-kernels' `==4.6.2`), and it is **below** what the FROST-derived kernels need (`CUTEDSL_MIN_VERSION`, 4.7.0).
